caveat: Memoria affidabile, tempi no: la macchina era carica durante la campagna (CPU media 68% nella campagna tabellare, 52% in quella geo; fino a 40 processi di build). La metrica e' PeakWorkingSet64 incrementale (mediana delle ripetizioni meno la mediana della baseline), non un'allocazione esatta; nessun fattore di sicurezza applicato. Misurato a 24698d6: prima delle parti preparate della validazione OGC (fd3325c, 2697f72) e del runner geo di F4 (2ca8b45, 9e45538, e79d9ee).

semantics.memory_metric: median over repetitions of PeakWorkingSet64 read at the measurement_ready barrier (inputs and output alive); incremental = median(operation) - median(baseline)
semantics.budget_estimate: max(incremental peak, phase WS growth operation - baseline); peak_masked_by_fixture_transient when phase growth > 2x incremental peak and > 1 MiB
semantics.buffer_accounting: Arrow buffers deduplicated by allocation start (Buffer::data_ptr), counted by capacity; output_new = output allocations not shared with any input allocation
semantics.geo_execution: input RecordBatch with GeoArrow-WKB geometry column(s); decode_geometry_cell (WKB contract + OGC validation) -> kernel (*_validated variant when available; product Arrow entry points *_batches/*_column/*_rows/*_wkb/transform_wkb when available) -> encode_geometry -> output RecordBatch; rows parallel via rayon as map_nullable; rayon pool started before input_ready in both modes
semantics.geo_axes: features = rows of the primary table; vertices = requested coordinates per feature (actual total in input_vertices); input_wkb_bytes = sum of WKB payload bytes of all geometry columns
